Subject : — Inviting Suggestions on Proforma of Compliance Audit Report of Exempted/Relaxed
Establishments - Regarding.

Sir,

Please refer to the subject cited above. It is proposed to revise proforma of Compliance Audit
Report of exempted/relaxed establishments to be submitted by the Compliance Audit Squad to the
Regional PF Commissioners consequent upon completion of audit.

2. In this connection, please find enclosed herewith a draft Compliance Audit Report. It is requested
to suggest suitable amendments to the draft Compliance Audit Report. Suggestion should reach Head
Office by 15.12.2015 through e-mail only. All suggestions should be sent to e-mail Id
acc.compliance@epfindia.gov.in with a copy to rc.exemption@epfindia.gov.in and due care should be
taken that it is in .pdf as well as in .doc format.

Yours faithfully

arn

(M. Narayanappa)
Addl. Central PF Commissioner-I
Telephone No.- 011-26172672
